items.title: Dino Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Are they fearsome or are they cute? We'll let you decide what these teens are.

*11 dino teens
*1 free skin

items.title: Chibi Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Do you like Chibis? Or Teens? Well this is the pack for you then, as we have both! 

*16 chibis + teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Lunar New Year
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
For many, the new year has already kicked off. For others, its only just begun!

*12 new year skins
*2 free skins

items.title: Pink Out Demons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
These demons are back but cuter than ever. With pink attire and pink horns, let out your inner demons in fashionable style. These modern teen skins have the perfect fashion designs to look good anywhere. Don't forget pink is cool too!

- 12 pink out demon skins
- Modern designs for teens
- Perfect for roleplay
- Great for Valentine's Day!

items.title: Plastic Style Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Teens in Plastic Minecraft style! The most trendy outfits in plastic vanilla style for your game.

+ Free Dave skin!
+ By Blockline.

items.title: Furniture: Modern Makeover
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Modern furniture is back! Decorate your world with colorful furniture for any room you want. Use brushes to paint with 16 different colors. Become an interior designer in this modern world!

- Modern neighborhood
- Plenty of homes to decorate
- Paintable furniture
- 50+ furniture pieces

items.title: Neon Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Want to dress up as a mob but with an interesting twist? If you're into a cyberpunk or neon style, these skins are for you! Unique and interesting patterns in colorful pixels available. 

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Eastern Skylands
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Travel island to island to fight or build in this classic-style survival challenge map. Survive, thrive, or fall victim to the elements in this wacky twist on an old classic.

By Project Moonboot

items.title: Genie Spirits HD
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Genie spirits are waiting for someone to release them! Free them from the magic lamps, get your 3 wishes. Be careful what you wish for because it might just come true!

- 10 HD skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Haunted Mansion
items.creator: Enchanted
items.description:
Explore a spooky mansion that touches the sky! Search through the haunted floors and fight off the undead whom have made their home inside. Look out for hidden rooms for safety and their epic rewards!
- Unique rooms to explore
- 2 free skins
- By Enchanted

items.title: Dinosaur Adventure
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
A world full of dinosaurs is waiting for you! 
Roam the world with herds of herbivores, fight against the carnivores or compete with the dangerous Alpha-Rex!

+2 free HD cave people skins
+15 tameable dinosaurs
+Custom landscape to start your survival adventure!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Camo Hide & Seek
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Ready for the ultimate hide & seek? Choose whether you play in a moden mansion, castle or western town! Choose a camo skin and hide well from the seeker! As a hider you can select a block camo! As a seeker you have different abilities to help you find the hiders! No friends online? Play with NPCs!

+NPCs and abilities!
+In-game camo skins!
+Special seeker abilities!

items.title: CRAFTING HOUSES!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Survival with a new twist! Craft your new house and build towns, cities, empires and epic hideouts! This map offers 16 new craftable bases you can craft anywhere you want.
+Great for your new survival adventure!
+16 craftable Minecraft houses and bases!
+A volcano base, cave base, treehouse and many more!
+Play alone or with friends!

items.title: Kings & Queens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Welcome into this new magical kingdom! Get to know every part of this fantastic realm and meet fancy teens. Become best friends and see how kings and queens are living! Move-in the tallest tower, on the highest hill, and live like a truly royal lifestyle! 

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Chicken Block'D
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Chicken Block'D! The highly anticipated sequel is here! 

A fun & unique skyblock adventure awaits you, with all new features and gameplay mechanics to completely change the way you play. 

- 70+ new Chickens to collect.
- A whole new Egg & Incubator system.
- 8 uniquely themed islands.
- A trophy room to see all of your progress.
- Lucky Blocks!
- 5 Skins included.

items.title: The Milky Way Texture Pack
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These are the most epic textures in the universe! Equip these custom blocks and free your Minecraft worlds from being boring! Escape reality and update your cities & spawns with bright, colorful, and fun blocks! Or, just apply them to your secret bases in the sky!
* Epic free skins!
* Creative opportunities!
* Space robots will never be the same!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Secret Agents
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Pssst, the secret agents are recruiting for their missions! 
It's your chance to join them and start your mysterious adventure today.

+ 12 mob secret agents, creating the ultimate Minecraft spy squad!
+ Get a taste of the agent life and take part in secret missions on your worlds.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Lucky Block Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Equip the latest lucky block fashion and enjoy the supreme trend!
Coming in 12 different colors, you have plenty of choices to find the lucky teen that suits you best.

+ 12 teens, ready to spread the ultimate lucky block vibes!
+ Choose your lucky teen and let the adventure begin.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Cute Vibes Texture Pack
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
This bright and vibrant texture pack is packed full of unique textures that are sure to heighten your gaming experience! Decorate your house with beautiful colors and a modern look! Check out the different animals, plants, and blocks you can interact with.

+ Beautifully crafted textures!
+ Custom mob and villager looks!
+ Upgrade your game with this amazing texture pack!

items.title: Millionaire Mansions
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Experience a luxurious mansion lifestyle with a beautiful cliffside view! Featuring a wide array of unique rooms, pools, and more for you and your friends to explore!

- 7 large and unique modern mansions
- Beautiful tropical cliffside terrain 
- By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Giant Turtles
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ride the waves in this fun, ocean-themed survival map! Prepare to set sail and search for hidden treasure alongside magnificent aquatic creatures. If you get tired, you can always rest on a giant turtle’s shell!

- Custom underwater environment
- Treasure hunting
- 6 aquatic islands
- 3 turtle skins
- Licensed by LeadPro and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Cloud Survival
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Team Workbench presents: Cloud Survival! Ever had a dream that you were in the sky? In Minecraft Cloud Survival you can live on top of the clouds or blow them up with TNT. Find your way to the nether and slay the ender dragon in the end. 

+ Custom Villager trades
+ Cloud Survival world in the sky
+ Licensed by Team Workbench and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: CupCraft
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you a real gamer? Can you beat the hardest game of all time? So show that you are a real pro with this CupCraft skin pack! Colorful characters in a cartoon world are just waiting for you to play with them!

- 11 CupCraft skins!
- Ideal for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Elemental Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
These legendary teens control the power of the elements, and can cast powerful spells to defeat their opponents.
Fire, earth, water, air, earth, thunder, dark magic... Form an army with your friends and set out to conquer the land!

- 10 epic elemental teens skins!
- Make you stand out in the crowd!
- Ideal for role-playing with friends!
- By Pixelusion
